newsitem.title: USA: Ariz. Palo Verde 1 nuclear unit begins startup.
newsitem.headline: Ariz. Palo Verde 1 nuclear unit begins startup.

text.p: The 1,221 megawatt (MW) Palo Verde nuclear unit 1 began restart, following a scheduled refueling and maintenance outage that began September 21, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Wednesday.
The operator, Arizona Public Service Co (APS), earlier told Reuters the unit would resume operation this week.
The two nearby units, each also at 1,221 MW, were producing at full output, NRC said in its daily status report.

APS, a subsidiary of Pinnacle West Capital Corp, has a 29.1 percent interest in the Wintersburg, Ariz., nuclear plant. The company's stake in Palo Verde accounts for roughly 30 percent of its generation capacity.
Other owners include Edison International's Southern California Eidosn Co, El Paso Electric Co and Public Service Co of New Mexico.
